purpose: Visual Bible references; no generated pixels serve as application UI

records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: a single full-screen desktop chapter concept for DOSE, an immersive editorial study of the architecture of a hypothetical uncoated immediate-release tablet made by direct compression.
Output: exactly one 1536 x 1024 landscape image, one coherent website section, not a collage, not a contact sheet.
Art direction: exceptionally refined Swiss editorial typography, nearly black slightly green ink, generous silence, warm porcelain-gray studio background, mineral-teal accent used sparingly, honest chalk-white powder textures. Large clean grotesk typography, very thin rules, wide letterspaced monospace microcopy. Tangible believable macro CGI, physically plausible roughness and subtle pores; all geometry must be feasible to model procedurally in Three.js. No consumer product packaging, no medical efficacy claims, no branding other than DOSE.
Shared chrome: at the top left, tiny outlined circle with one horizontal and one vertical rule inside, then letterspaced "D O S E"; top right "Index +" then "About"; generous 64 px inset and one thin horizontal divider spanning the content width under the navigation. At the bottom around y=930, one thin horizontal divider with a tiny chapter label at left and "A STUDY IN MATERIAL & SCALE" at right. Keep these all typographic and understated.
Avoid: cards, rounded panels, boxed content, dashboards, HUD, neon blue, glowing particles, holographic devices, scanners, invented scientific results or measurements, fake microscopy/SEM images, excessive crosshairs, gradients as visual decoration, futuristic lab gimmicks. This image is only a visual design reference, not executable UI.
Chapter 01 / MATERIAL.
Scene: warm porcelain white, large quiet negative space. Upper left below the nav, huge black headline reading exactly "Matter,\nwith purpose." across two lines, occupying the left 48% and remaining clearly legible.
In the right side and lower half, show three distinct floating non-luminous material types in a loose, purposeful diagonal composition: (1) a cluster of angular opaque pale mineral-teal crystals as a schematic active ingredient, with subdued natural ceramic-mineral surfaces, emphatically not metallic; (2) chalk-white porous irregular chunks of excipient matrix, structurally like credible microcrystalline compressed powder agglomerates, not a biological cell; (3) smaller warm-gray granular processing-aid particles, like fine muted sand clusters. Sparse tiny loose grains can connect the groups, but do not make a decorative particle swarm.
Use soft daylight shadows and strong tactile differentiation. Fine short annotation lines to readable labels exactly "Active ingredient", "Excipient matrix", and "Processing aids". One tiny unobtrusive note "MORPHOLOGY IS ILLUSTRATIVE". Bottom left: "01 / MATERIAL". The material objects must look restrained and modelable, not alien matter.
records.review: Inspected the generated tool image: requested material, composition, wording and non-clinical conceptual labels are present. No card/HUD/neon pattern.
